name: Kanto National Dex
description: National Dex content for Red, Blue, Yellow, Gold, Silver, and Crystal. R/B/Y retain the established Kanto tables; G/S/C spread progression-balanced Gen 1-9 encounters across native Johto and postgame Kanto. Includes complete normal/shiny sprite sets, starter gifts, legendary quests/statics, the Regigigas Chamber, a 1,025-species Pokédex location catalog, evolutions, and integrated QoL/CHEATS.
